context_requirements: Intact actin-myosin contractility and ROCK/MLCK signaling
Proliferative capacity to reveal anti-proliferative and apoptotic effects
Functional apoptotic machinery (caspases) for late apoptotic gene expression
falsifiers: No change in proliferation or apoptosis markers at 24 h in any cell line
No reduction in MYL9 phosphorylation or contractility-related genes
Lack of dose-dependent effects at 10 µM
Predominant upregulation of proliferation genes instead of downregulation

evidence.supports: ML-7, an MLCK inhibitor, induces dose- and time-dependent cytotoxicity and apoptosis in HL-60 cells
ML-7 enhances fragmentation of myotubes, indicating a role for MLCK in cytoskeletal regulation
ML-9, an MLCK inhibitor, blocks membrane blebbing in HEK293 cells
ML-7 reverses ROCK-II-induced membrane blebbing and chromatin condensation

changes: Removed MYC, FOS, JUN, EGR1, CCND1, MYCBP, MYCBP2 from proximal_up: MLCK inhibition does not directly induce these genes; they are generic stress/proliferation markers.
Removed all genes from proximal_down: no immediate transcriptional targets of MLCK are known; the listed cell-cycle genes are generic proliferation markers.
Kept MYL9 in proximal_up as a potential feedback response to MLCK inhibition.
Moved cell-cycle genes to late_down only, reflecting secondary anti-proliferative effects at 24 h.
Kept late_up genes as generic stress/apoptosis markers.
No changes to kinetics, magnitude, line_response, context_requirements, falsifiers, or evidence.
